Meet Jen

Jen Jenivive is a UK author of beautifully illustrated books for grown-ups who never quite grew up. What started as one very silly idea is now a full-blown library of innuendo with 190 million views and counting — read aloud, badly, at hen dos, birthdays and book clubs around the world.

“They might look like children's books, but they are definitely just for adults!”
